description: This PHP source file defines the UserDemoData class used for creating and managing demo user data within the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM system. It includes methods for creating seed users, generating user lists, and handling demo data setup.

classes.name: UserDemoData
classes.description: A class for generating demo user data, including creating seed users and handling large-scale demo setups.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for initializing UserDemoData with a seed user and optional large scale test flag.

methods.name: create_demo_data
methods.description: Creates demo users based on predefined data, and generates additional users if large scale testing is enabled.

methods.name: _create_seed_user
methods.description: Creates a seed user with specified attributes and saves it to the database.

methods.name: _seed_data_get_user_list
methods.description: Returns a list of predefined user names for demo purposes.

methods.name: _quick_create_user
methods.description: Quickly creates a demo user if it does not already exist.
